finalCta.body: Send a few photos or pick a time for an inspection. You'll get a clear quote before any work is booked.

faq.a: Yes. We specialise in Decramastic repairs and restoration, as well as tile and tin roofs.

faq.q: What painting systems do you offer?
faq.a: Everything from standard roof paint through to thermal systems. Ask what suits your roof.
Rockhampton, Yeppoon, Gladstone and the surrounding areas.

faq.q: Do you install whirlybirds and gutter guard?
faq.a: Yes. Whirlybirds in zinc or Colorbond, gutter guard, skylights and guttering.

faq.q: What happens after I send a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight through, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to arrange your inspection.
